plugins.description: Recolors BB in neutral graphite greys for light and dark mode, with sticky headers that blur what scrolls under them.
plugins.overview:
A calm graphite look for BB in light and dark mode.

The theme swaps BB's colors for neutral graphite greys with soft borders, and sticky headers blur whatever scrolls under them instead of cutting it off.

Turn it on with `bb theme set plugin:graphite:graphite`, and back off with `bb theme set default`.

plugins.description: Widens the thread, softens reply typography, and slims the prompt box with quiet Send controls.
plugins.overview:
An easier-to-read thread screen.

The chat uses more of a wide window while each paragraph keeps a comfortable line length. Replies use lighter, slightly smaller type with clear gaps between paragraphs, lists, and headings, close to the Claude desktop app, and links and inline code stand out in blue and red. The prompt box is shorter on desktop, and its Send button becomes a quiet icon like the controls next to it.

Only the look changes; messages, code blocks, tools, drafts, and shortcuts behave as before. Disable Thread View to get BB's original screen back.

plugins.description: Adds a project rail with per-project Sessions, a read-only file Explorer, and reusable bot profiles.
plugins.overview:
A project-first sidebar for BB. Projects sit in a rail on the left, the selected project's sessions sit beside them, and an Explorer tab browses the project's files. The chat, composer, providers, and previews stay BB's own.

## Projects and sessions

Pick a project in the rail to see its sessions, including projects that have none yet. Sessions keep BB's search, pins, drafts, read state, and live status: a spinner while an agent works, amber when it needs input, green for an unread reply, red for an error. Projects with activity show colored counts. Right-click a session for open, split, pin, rename, archive, or delete. Use **+** beside Projects to add a project by machine and folder.

Choose how much each session card shows under **Session cards**: Detailed, Compact, or Title only.

## Explorer

The Explorer tab reads the project's folder as soon as you select the project, without opening a chat. Folders load as you expand them. Clicking a file opens it in BB's file preview. Explorer is read-only: it never edits files or runs commands.

## Bots

Bots are reusable specialist profiles, such as a code reviewer or a release manager. Each has a name, a role, a mascot, instructions, a separate SOUL.md personality, and optional model defaults. Start a chat with a bot from its menu. Mentioning a bot with **@** references it in another chat without running it. Each bot keeps separate memory per project, which you can read and correct in its Memory tab. Bots can coordinate with each other only after you allow it for the current work.

## Switching back

Open Settings → Plugins → Project Workspace and choose **Default BB** to return to the standard thread list. Disabling the plugin does the same. Your projects, sessions, and chats are never moved or deleted.

plugins.description: Remembers each thread’s Fast mode choice per model across thread switches and app reloads.
plugins.overview:
Fast mode choices now survive leaving a chat and returning, even before a message is sent.

The plugin remembers each existing thread’s selected service tier separately for each provider and model. Turning Fast off is remembered too. Preferences survive reloading the app in the same browser or desktop profile.

It uses BB’s composer API and adds no controls. BB still decides which tiers a provider and model support. New-thread, queued-message, and sent-message editors are left to BB.

Preferences stay in local app/browser storage and do not sync between devices. Disable Fast Mode Memory to return to BB’s native behavior.
